pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Sneak-use an appropriate sword/crossbow on an eligible unemployed villager/nitwit. Use native patrol controls. Hero of the Village enables follow/bell rally; clerics, smiths and spare food support guards only under enabled native settings.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Creation, patrol, heroic following and professional support are distinct native states, not one villager click.
